claims.text: The proposed model outperforms the previous best model by 2% in EM score and over 1.5% in F1 score.
The performance gap when training on mismatched data is nearly 20% F1 score, indicating the model's effectiveness after fine-tuning.
The proposed model demonstrates superior performance in the Spoken-SQuAD domain compared to baselines.
